name: Jam MCP
description: Gives coding agents a Jam bug report's video, console logs, network requests, and user events from a pasted Jam link, via Jam's hosted MCP server.

skills.name: Read Console Logs
skills.description: Gets the console logs captured in a Jam, filtered by log level and paged with a cursor to cut noise while debugging.

skills.name: List Network Requests
skills.description: Lists every web request from a Jam with status code, content type, host, and method filters, plus error response bodies.

skills.name: See the Screen
skills.description: Returns frames from a video Jam at chosen timestamps or as one overview grid, plus the reporter's spoken transcript.

skills.name: Search Jams
skills.description: Searches Jams by text across titles, descriptions, comments, linked issues, and transcripts, filtered by author, folder, or date.

skills.name: Comment on Jams
skills.description: Adds Markdown comments and replies to a Jam, labeled with the agent's name, and can mention a teammate to notify them.
